_about: Mutation target for the theme installer. A theme is data, so install.sh is
the only executable surface — the file a broken cd/guard would silently
corrupt. The colour contract itself is pinned by the unit/regression tests.

equivalent.reason: the mutated digit is the file descriptor in '>&2'; '>&3' only redirects the diagnostic to an unopened fd. Control flow and exit status are unchanged, and no test asserts on the diagnostic stream.

exempt.reason: theme DATA, not code — there is nothing to mutate. Its correctness (every slot present, well-formed colours, WCAG contrast) is asserted directly by tests/test_unit_theme.py and tests/test_regression_theme.py.
